expected_outcome.description: Block the change: `verifyWebhookSignature` is async, and line 6 of `src/routes/payment-webhook.ts` calls it without `await`, so `valid` is a Promise, `!valid` is always false and the 401 branch never runs. Anyone can post a forged `payment.succeeded` event to the public webhook and have any order marked as paid. A blocking finding must identify the missing `await` (the signature check that never rejects) and fix it by awaiting the call.
